finalText:
I audited all 19 baggage fees posted 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-26 and recorded a verdict on each one. Eleven were correct, six were overcharged and have now been refunded (37,000 cents in total), and two were undercharged and will not be re-billed.

**What I checked first:** I re-read the ledger, the baggage rules, both bulletins, and every passenger's tier history and booking history. Everything matched the plan:
- **Tiers that changed:** Jakob Weiss was gold until 07-21, Tara Singh was silver until 07-22, and Quinn Harper had no tier until 07-22.
- **Cabins that changed:** R8120 and R8123 moved up to premium economy on 07-22 and 07-23, after their fees were charged.
- **Price change:** bulletin PB-2026-13 raises the first chargeable bag from 4500 to 5000 cents for fees charged from 07-23. Each further bag stays at 7500. The other bulletin (PB-2026-11) covers seat fees, so it doesn't apply.

**Verdicts:**
- **Correct (11):** L2, L6, L8, L9, L11, L12, L13, L16, L17, L18, L21. L21 is not a double charge: it covers a new third bag on R8122, which is its second chargeable bag, so 7500 is right.
- **Undercharged (2), not re-billed:** L4 (3,000 short) and L20 (500 short).
- **Overcharged (6), refunded to the original payment method:**

| Fee | Booking | Refund (cents) | New ledger entry | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L3 | R8125 | 12,000 | L25 | Gold on the charge date, so all 3 bags were free |
| L5 | R8116 | 5,500 | L26 | Overcharged by 7,500, minus the 2,000 another agent already refunded (L24) |
| L7 | R8118 | 4,500 | L27 | Silver, so both bags were free |
| L10 | R8113 | 7,500 | L28 | Basic economy plus silver allows 1 free bag, so only 1 bag was chargeable |
| L15 | R8119 | 2,500 | L29 | One chargeable bag at the new 5,000 price |
| L19 | R8114 | 5,000 | L30 | Charged a second time for the same bags as L18, so refunded in full |

**Where the plan was off:**
- The plan gave two different totals; 37,000 is the correct sum of the six refunds.
- One version said L22 might be a baggage fee. The ledger shows it is a change fee.

**Payment details:** the payment check said "no payment instrument on file" for all six refunded bookings. That doesn't say the card is inactive, and every refund went through to the original payment method.

**Left alone:** L1 and L23 (outside the date window), L14 and L22 (change fees), and L24 (the earlier refund). No customer requests were involved, so there was nothing to resolve in the queue.
